verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Simular issues a Sai API key (SAI_API_KEY=sapi_...) for driving agents. Nothing documents scoping, permission limits, or least-privilege credential issuance. Approval prompts before sensitive steps are a related runtime control, not scoped credentials, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
